species.description: Narrow irregular dark blue-green spire with separated snowy branch ledges.
Full cool sage-green conical crown with restrained ivory snow on upper boughs.
Asymmetric drooping blue-green evergreen, crooked leader and light snow.
Slim dense pointed dark green crown with broad pale snow bands.
Open golden olive conical crown, clear horizontal branches and cool bark.
Airy narrow muted bronze-green needle crown on a tall exposed brown trunk.
Thin upright rugged pine with a small narrow crown and snowy branch forks.
Crooked open grey trunk, spreading dark needle cushions and a bent leader.
Sculptural twisted pale ancient trunk, sparse separated dark foliage cushions.

job.prompt:
Production asset: exactly NINE different isolated individual trees in a transparent3x3 equal-cell sprite atlas, row-major order. Match the supplied approved game artwork in palette, camera, shading and painterly material treatment.
Fixed orthographic2:1 dimetric game camera; ground axes at+26.565/-26.565 degrees, no perspective convergence. Northwest daylight, restrained warm hand-painted miniature style. Full crowns, trunks, roots and a tiny soft contact shadow are visible.
Shared physical scale with game buildings: one ground tile is16m square, an adult is1.75m and a door is2.1m. Do not draw people, doors or buildings. The normalized256px cell uses13.15px per vertical metre. Tree heights vary naturally; do not enlarge shorter species to fill their cells.
Every tree root meets the shared horizontal baseline at95.5% of its cell height, centred horizontally. Crown and all branches stay inside their own cell with generous transparent gutters. Keep side gutters at least12% of cell width and top gutters at least10%. Tiny contact shadows fade out before the cell bottom. No long baked directional shadow; the game supplies the projected ground shadow.
Broad asymmetrical foliage masses and clear species silhouettes readable at Region and Town zoom. A few large boughs and trunk forks; no individual leaves, fine needle lines, stippling, scratches, tiny bark fissures, tiny fruit dots, lettering or botanical labels. Each requested species has distinct branch architecture and crown proportions.
Genuine transparent RGBA background; no coloured backdrop, checkerboard, ground rectangle, floating plinth, pots, frame, labels or UI. Exactly one whole tree per cell; no forest groups.
Cold northern woodland: cool sage and blue-green, pale bark, restrained ivory snow on upper branches and at roots. Keep tree anatomy visible.
Slot 1: black-spruce, 13m tall, 170.9px vertical tree height in the normalized256px cell. Narrow irregular dark blue-green spire with separated snowy branch ledges.
Slot 2: white-spruce, 15m tall, 197.2px vertical tree height in the normalized256px cell. Full cool sage-green conical crown with restrained ivory snow on upper boughs.
Slot 3: mountain-hemlock, 13m tall, 170.9px vertical tree height in the normalized256px cell. Asymmetric drooping blue-green evergreen, crooked leader and light snow.
Slot 4: subalpine-fir, 15m tall, 197.2px vertical tree height in the normalized256px cell. Slim dense pointed dark green crown with broad pale snow bands.
Slot 5: siberian-larch, 14m tall, 184.1px vertical tree height in the normalized256px cell. Open golden olive conical crown, clear horizontal branches and cool bark.
Slot 6: tamarack, 13m tall, 170.9px vertical tree height in the normalized256px cell. Airy narrow muted bronze-green needle crown on a tall exposed brown trunk.
Slot 7: northern-lodgepole-pine, 14m tall, 184.1px vertical tree height in the normalized256px cell. Thin upright rugged pine with a small narrow crown and snowy branch forks.
Slot 8: limber-pine, 12m tall, 157.8px vertical tree height in the normalized256px cell. Crooked open grey trunk, spreading dark needle cushions and a bent leader.
Slot 9: bristlecone-pine, 10m tall, 131.5px vertical tree height in the normalized256px cell. Sculptural twisted pale ancient trunk, sparse separated dark foliage cushions.
